what: Round 7c (adc8bbbf04, /Volumes/Projects/.coord-1030/v2-build/round7c-test.log line 35145): blaze-premap tests::image_key_changes_with_every_instance panics at blaze-mem tag.rs:173:15 'attempt to add with overflow' in tag::add, from Region::publish (region.rs:279) <- Region::grow <- ensure <- chunks::carve <- chunks::take <- frame::Shelf::take_chunk (frame.rs:1002). `add` computes `live.fetch_add(b) + b` in checked arithmetic, so the overflow means `live` had already wrapped below zero: some `sub` (fetch_sub wraps silently) or `transfer` took more bytes off the tag than were ever added to it. The fix is in the accounting, finding the sub or transfer without a matching add, not a wrapping add that hides it. A debug assertion in `sub` that `live` does not go below zero (`fetch_sub` returning >= bytes) would name the path. Premap passed 23 of 24 tests; this test passed in round 6.
